scenes.title: Articulated porcelain pigeon spinning counterclockwise before the 15-second grain hopper

layout.description: Sunlit late-1940s experimental psychology room with a clear-walled aluminum-and-acrylic operant conditioning box resting on a wooden bench beside an electromechanical interval timer dial marked in 15-second ticks.

positions.where: inside the clear operant chamber executing a crisp counterclockwise full turn
positions.facing: pivoting smoothly toward the lower rectangular grain-hopper aperture

positions.who: B. F. Skinner (mannequin in 1940s white lab coat over shirt and tie)
positions.where: leaning slightly beside the benchtop cumulative recorder drum and 15-second timer
positions.facing: observing the matte-white porcelain pigeon's ritual turn

props.name: clear-walled operant conditioning chamber
props.period_detail: compact aluminum-framed box with wire-mesh floor and recessed lower grain-hopper window
props.physical_behavior: illuminates and swings the grain tray open every 15 seconds on a blind solenoid click

props.name: 15-second interval timer dial
props.period_detail: 1940s round electromechanical sweep timer wired directly to the hopper solenoid
props.physical_behavior: hand sweeps steadily past the 15-second mark without any connection to cage keys

props.name: cumulative paper-drum recorder
props.period_detail: rotating white paper cylinder with stepped ink stylus
props.physical_behavior: steps briskly upward during the 10,000-response extinction test

actions.verb_sequence: completes two brisk counterclockwise circles in the center of the chamber -> freezes facing the wall -> dips beak as the 15-second grain hopper clicks open
points from the disconnected cage wall to the 15-second timer dial -> notes the ritual turn on a clipboard

reactions.reaction: immediately launches into an even tighter counterclockwise spin the moment the hopper closes
watches in quiet amazement as pure coincidence locks in a rigid motor ritual

scenes.wardrobe: Experimenter mannequin in crisp 1940s white cotton lab coat, collared shirt, dark tie; subject staged as an articulated matte-white porcelain pigeon sculpture.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key 1940s laboratory daylight across brushed aluminum and clear acrylic.
scenes.recognition_hook: A hungry porcelain pigeon spins counterclockwise in an operant box because a blind 15-second timer keeps opening the grain tray mid-spin.

key_visual.description: an articulated porcelain pigeon executing a counterclockwise ritual turn inside a clear operant box right as the 15-second grain hopper clicks open

scenes.title: Six chambers, six idiosyncratic rituals

layout.description: Row of clear operant boxes on a long wooden table where one porcelain pigeon bows toward an upper corner while another tosses its head upward.

positions.where: in adjacent clear chambers performing distinct head-toss and corner-thrust rituals
walking along the bench comparing tally sheets

props.name: six numbered operant boxes
props.period_detail: identical chambers all wired to one master 15-second timer
props.physical_behavior: all six hoppers click open simultaneously regardless of bird posture

actions.verb_sequence: repeat distinct corner-bowing and head-tossing loops -> peck when the shared timer clicks

reactions.reaction: compares the six divergent movement logs on his clipboard

scenes.wardrobe: 1940s white lab coat; matte-white porcelain pigeon sculptures.
scenes.recognition_hook: Identical 15-second timers produce completely personalized rituals across six cages.

scenes.title: Ten thousand hops during disconnected extinction

layout.description: Close view of the cumulative paper-drum recorder beside a single operant chamber with its hopper power cord visibly unplugged.

positions.where: performing rapid rhythmic stepping motions inside the chamber
standing beside the unplugged timer cable and rising cumulative ink curve

props.name: unplugged solenoid plug and mechanical tally counter
props.period_detail: bakelite power plug resting beside the timer while mechanical counter passes 10000
props.physical_behavior: counter digits roll past 10,000 unrewarded responses

actions.verb_sequence: continues rhythmic hopping ritual long after the hopper stays dark

scenes.recognition_hook: Over 10,000 unrewarded ritual steps before the accidental habit finally extinguishes.

scenes.title: Modern commuter mashing a disconnected crosswalk button

layout.description: Bright sunlit city crosswalk where a pedestrian mannequin taps a metal push-button repeatedly just as the automated traffic signal happens to turn white.

positions.where: standing at the curb pressing the metal crosswalk button five times

props.name: automated crosswalk button housing
props.period_detail: yellow metal pedestrian box controlled by a fixed intersection cycle
props.physical_behavior: walk icon illuminates on its preset schedule right after the fifth tap

actions.verb_sequence: taps the button rapidly -> sees the walk sign light up -> nods with false satisfaction

reactions.reaction: steps briskly off the curb convinced the rapid tapping changed the light

scenes.wardrobe: Modern tailored trench coat and commuter bag.
scenes.recognition_hook: Your brain stamps in button-mashing the exact same way Skinner's timer stamped in the matte-white porcelain pigeon's spin.
